_provenance: Measured on 2026-11-01 with scripts/ci/macosMinOs.mjs on the published 0.22.1 macOS bundle (ArtDaddy-macos-arm64.app.tar.gz, sha256 AE82F6C42C3E5367573CE90D8002627C4A2A05DC14C72D982D8C2E731A6CD657, 12 Mach-O files).
_why: tauri.conf.json advertises macOS 11.0 and these files already need more. The owner decided on 2026-11-01 to leave the advertised version as it is and revisit it later. Until then each entry is a CEILING for its files: a build fails when a file needs MORE than its ceiling (and, for a file not listed here, more than the advertised minimum). So the runner move or a toolchain change cannot raise any floor unnoticed. When the advertised version is raised to cover the highest ceiling below (or the over-claimers are removed from the bundle), delete this file.
